item.title: Which RimWorld DLC Should You Buy First?
item.description: There are 5 RimWorld DLCs (including Odyssey). If you're wondering which to buy first, this guide ranks them by value for different playstyles. All 5 RimWorld DLCs DLCAddsBest for RoyaltyEmpire faction, titles, psionics, mech clustersPlayers who like structured goals and magic-like powers. IdeologyBelief systems, rituals, social roles, dryadsStory and roleplay players who enjoy customizing colonies. BiotechChildren, mechanoids, genetics, xenohumansLong-term colony builders who love depth and family lines. AnomalyHorror entities, containment, alternate endingsPlayers who want danger, mystery and a darker tone.
